questions.question: Who has achieved the 150 runs and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Anneke Bosch or Lanette Pienaar?
questions.explanation: Anneke Bosch: 1 times. Lanette Pienaar: 2 times.

questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 301, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.

questions.question: South Africa Women played their first ODI in August 1997, 25 years after their last Test before an extended absence from international cricket. Who was the opponent, and where was it played?
questions.explanation: South Africa's first ODI after readmission to international cricket was against Ireland at Stormont, Belfast, on 5 August 1997.

questions.question: Sunette Loubser set a database record (07/08 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 35. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Maidens', held by Sunette Loubser.

questions.question: At which ground did Melissa van der Merwe record their career-best bowling figures (3-6, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at St George's Park, against Warriors on 2024/03/03.

questions.question: How many matches played separate the all-time #1 (Yolandi Potgieter) and #2 (Nonkhululeko Thabethe) players (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Yolandi Potgieter: 212 — Nonkhululeko Thabethe: 207 — a gap of 5.
